execution.ref: claude/dev-contract-variants from claude/conditional-exploration e2b47479d (GRAPHITE-DEV-VARIANTS-01, W1 of OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-03)
execution.description: Built the development-only construction-contract variant mechanism: a registered, digest-pinned variant policy held outside CONTRACTS with an empty shipped registry, development expansion records under expansions/<token>/dev, a development-only compile path, --level for Graphite phases 3 and 4, a typed refusal on every miner-facing door, and the Test Lead's W2 review items 2 and 6 and the climb nit.

expected: A development level runs only Carbon's own campaigns, under a variant the registry pins, and every miner-facing door refuses that variant by name without importing the variant module. Level 0 behaves exactly as before.
observed: The doors need to recognise a variant without importing the variant module, so they read the variant registry as data: one reader in the capability registry. That reader is now a runtime dependency of every miner door, so the registry ships as package data and a missing one fails closed. A behavioural test per door was not enough on its own: behind most doors the compiler or the adapter lookup would still refuse a variant under a generic code, so only switching each door's own check off showed it was there. W2's 'development' was a caller's say-so; once only registered variant digests are accepted, a development entry stripped of its kind and tags still names a variant, which is what lets the LOCK ledger refuse it statically. The bundle's clean rebuild and the synthetic pods also compiled through Level 0, which would have hidden a development-level mismatch, so they now go through the variant too.
keep: Variants as registered, versioned, digest-pinned policy documents that are re-read at every lookup, so an altered document is refused where it is used.
Miner doors refuse by reading registry data only; an import-closure invariant with planted specimens proves the variant module stays unreachable.
One mutation per door's own check, because a deeper generic refusal hides a missing check.
No variant compiles without Carbon's registered reconstruction of every capability it widens.
change: Before adding a refusal, list every path that rebuilds a construction (host admission, pod, synthetic pod, bundle rebuild); each must take the same compile path or the rebuild check compares the wrong thing.
The first real Level 1-3 surfaces, their bounds and reconstructions go to the Test Lead for review before registration; Level 3 is a choice menu only until the Test Lead revises that rule.
